Bills pay first and the rest splits to the spokes by fixed rules, and the split redraws live.
Add a bill and remove a bill work.

features: Setup takes one or more free API keys or uses the shared key.
Tracks the restaurant ticker list with week, month and year views and a 1 day chart.
Sort by manual order, green first, red first or biggest movers, with a recent news filter.
Add, search and remove tickers.
Read aloud speaks the info text, and sync codes move settings between devices through the backend.

skwiggle.name: skwiggle
features: Drawing game where a line never stops, faster thins it and slower fattens it.

Pause, fill, erase, mask, clear mask and rewind work.
Zoom, reset view and hide UI work.
Save art downloads, share, AI filter and mint work, and the gallery opens.

skyflow-orange.name: skyflow-orange
features: Tower crane construction simulator loads in 3D and renders.

snapshot-engine-pied.name: snapshot-engine-pied
features: Snapshot engine responds instead of returning an error.

spaceout-mu.name: spaceout-mu
features: Tap to start a brick breaker game with score, wave and lives.
Paddle moves by swipe, drag or the left and right buttons, and fire launches the ball.
Stage clear advances to the next wave, and game over offers retry.
High score saves in the browser.

spectral-engin.name: spectral-engin
features: Drop or browse an MP3, MP4, WAV or M4A file to load it.

spectrastrain.name: spectrastrain

Category labels filter what shows.

spirits-atlas.name: spirits-atlas

stompbox-lab.name: stompbox-lab

Computer keyboard plays notes.
Account sign in, create and sign out sync the board through the backend.

stumbler.name: stumbler

Saved hits list with a count and export as json.

High scores take a three letter name and save in the browser.

termbeat.name: termbeat
features: Audio from a file or the microphone makes the terminal react to sound.

threat-atlas-two.name: threat-atlas-two

Intel and US states views list incidents with threat levels.

tile-spinner.name: tile-spinner

topdown-pixeltown.name: topdown-pixeltown

features: Build mode places beams of steel, wood or reinforced concrete between grid nodes within the budget.

Game tab runs a driving game with restart.
